prediction.likelyOutcome: 7205 Telegraph is likely to prevail on liability given the clear site-plan violation, the sharp before/after parking cut, and the undisclosed board self-dealing, but the damages award will land well short of its expert's top-end $1,340,000 diminution theory because the actual post-reallocation parking count (12 spaces) tracks much closer to the Association's own low-damage scenario. The over-assessment claim and the Association's lien counterclaim are unliquidated on this record and could offset each other depending on how the court treats the dues obligation once parking rights were curtailed.

outcome.description: After a bench trial the Fairfax County Circuit Court entered judgment for 7205 Telegraph on all four counts, awarding $481,434.84 in lost-rent contract damages, a further $6,296.70 for over-assessments, release of the association's liens, and $324,977.60 in attorney's fees and costs. A Court of Appeals panel affirmed on April 25, 2023; rehearing en banc was granted, and on December 19, 2023 the court lifted the stay and left the judgment affirmed.
outcome.finalNote: Affirmed, including after rehearing en banc.
